extractor.note: Whole file grep-scanned for the theme's search terms plus 'Wesensschau', 'eidetic', 'eidos', 'immutable', 'innate', 'Descartes', 'residuum' and 'free variation'. Closely read § 4(a) (lines 583-596), § 6(a) (649-662) and § 21 (499-512).

coverage_note: Covers § 4(a) (the science-theoretical character of the logical and noetic disciplines), § 6(a) (the principle-doctrines as clues for epistemological investigation) and § 21 (the convenience grounded in the essence of the will-act). Sections I-III and the remainder of the Formal Praktik were keyword-scanned only. The vocabulary here is 'essence-doctrine', 'essence-law' and 'essence-analysis' throughout; the eidetic terminology proper is absent from the file.

units.claim: A priori philosophy is characterized as an a priori doctrine of principles, the pure essence-doctrine and norm-doctrine of absolute being thought in formal generality.
units.quote: an apriori philosophical doctrine of principles, the pure essence-doctrine and norm-doctrine of absolute being thought in formal generality

units.claim: No facts are in principle derivable from essence-laws, which prescribe to the facts only possibilities, in the manner of ideal norms.
units.quote: for from essence-laws no facts are in principle to be derived, the essence-laws prescribing to the facts only possibilities, in the manner of ideal norms.

units.claim: A material a priori, the essence-laws of colour and tone and the like, is said to fall outside the formal ontologies, so that the formal a priori does not exhaust the a priori.
units.quote: there is a *material* apriori (the essence-laws of color, tone, and the like) that falls outside the formal ontologies

units.claim: The phenomenological-reason-critical dimension is said to concern the puzzling essence-relations between being and consciousness.
units.quote: it concerns the puzzling essence-relations between being and consciousness

units.claim: Whether a will-act is convenient or not is said to be wholly determined by the own essence of the respective will-act.
units.quote: it is clear that by the own essence of the respective will-act it is wholly determined whether it is convenient or not

units.claim: Judging insightfully about will-rightness in the objective attitude is described as performing an essence-analysis of the components that make up full rightness in the highest sense.
units.quote: performing an essence-analysis of the components that make up full rightness in the highest sense

absences.expected_because: This section lays out what an a priori essence-doctrine is and distinguishes formal from material essence-laws, so it is where the method by which essences are seen - and any comparison with a rationalist doctrine of innate or immutable natures - would be stated if the lectures stated it.
absences.note: The lectures secure essence-laws by insight and the parallel with pure logic, without any eidetic terminology and without naming Descartes anywhere in the file.
